svg.text: SQRL Acorn CLE-215+ to Raspberry Pi 5
Waveshare PoE M.2 HAT+ on a Pi 5. A Pi 4 or Pi 3B has the same 40-pin header and takes the same cable.
These are GPIO numbers, not header pin numbers
openFPGALoader --cable libgpiod, in the order TDI : TDO : TCK : TMS
Pi 5 with the PoE M.2 HAT+, from above
The header pins come up through the HAT along this edge
(shown here without the stacking header fitted).
pin 1 = the end nearest the M.2 edge
to a 2×3 Dupont housing on header pins 5 to 10
pin 1 = the end nearest the M.2 edge
to a 2×4 Dupont housing on header pins 19 to 26
Cut the VCC wire (pin 6) of BOTH cables. 3.3 V from the Acorn into the header can destroy the host.
Every wire in the Molex cables is black: count from pin 1.
Photos: Waveshare (PoE M.2 HAT+), RHS Research (LiteFury underside; the Acorn is the same PCB)
